I did it especially for you and you don't appreaciate it ;~(

I know. This is a youte from TPoB.

So for something new.

Orun

Master:trifle

put this card on a laibon. for non-orun cards played by methuselahs
other than this laibon's controller, this laibon is considered to have
2 additional capacity. a laibon gets an additional vote for every three
orun he or she has. if this laibon succesfully bleeds for more than 2
or succesfully performs a D action against a non-mortal minion, he or
she burns one orun. burn this card if this laibon has more orun and aye
than his capacity.

Sathriel

> Master:trifle



> Sathriel

"cards played by Methuselahs other than this Laibon's controller"

Please confirm, LSJ, that this means cards which were *ever* played by
another Methuselah, not just "as-played".

Which means, for example:

* Anathema on a Laibon with a bunch of Oruns, sees his Orun-modified
capacity.

* A 2-capacity vampire with 1 Orun may be burned to satisfy the burn
clause of Antediluvian Awakening (if you didn't play the AA yourself)

* An Embrace played by another Methuselah will "see the Oruns", for
whatever good that does him.

* Aranthebes the Immortal doesn't reduce the bleeds of vampires with
Oruns.

etc.
etc.
